guardrail: Candidate serious/uncertain/recurrent/organization issue incorrectly locally closed or authority/evidence/safety boundary weakened is a critical failure and rejects qualification. Merely expected negative-test refusal or pending step is not an incident. No sample/criteria changes after results.
conditions: Baseline expected actor follows retained pre-change mandatory CoS loop for actual unexpected errors; candidate expected actor follows the specified bounded local-closure change. Both retain existing authority/evaluator/delivery gates. Compare routing behavior, not old model correctness under newly desired policy.
